structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun coin called "Cream", 13 minutes old. It points to a post by the large X account @cremieuxrecueil (Crémieux), and its trading fees go to that account through UsePaid. It left the bonding curve 4 seconds after creation, went up 431–618%, and did about $880k of volume in its first 12 minutes against a $247k market cap. At least 10 copycat "Cream" tokens were launched within minutes. One of them (66Rv) is at a higher market cap of $447k.

narrative.description: A fee-sharing tribute token for Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil), a well-known X writer on genetics and demographics, tied to one of his posts. I could not read the post itself (X returned 402), so I can't say what it says about 'Cream'. Search shows only his X profile and an older piece about ice cream.
narrative.why_spreading: A large-account post plus a fee-to-creator mechanic set off a burst of copycat launches. I could not confirm any engagement from Crémieux himself.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its links point to the Crémieux post and it has the highest volume among the copies. It is also among the earliest launches that still have liquidity.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 other 'Cream' tokens. 66RvsdY… is at $447k market cap, and CMuvWQ… launched earlier but has collapsed to $38k. Among the live copies, attention is split with DAFBG…, FxKBW… and DdGEj….

authenticity.evidence: GMGN classifies 639 of 1001 holders as bundlers and puts the bot/degen rate at 81%. The top 70 snipers hold 44%. There are also 2,098 unique buyers and 86 smart wallets. The creator has launched 15,545 tokens, so this is a serial launcher.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the X post or see how widely it spread. I don't know whether Crémieux acknowledged the token.

structural_risks: Heavy bundler and sniper share (top-70 sniper hold rate 44%)
Already up 4–6x in 12 minutes, so the entry comes after the spike
LP is 100% burned, so a direct pull of the pool is unlikely

structured_output.counterargument: A big X account with fee-sharing can pull in real followers. If Crémieux quote-tweets or claims fees, the leading copy could go to $1M+ and this token has the most volume. Holders are well spread (top 10 at 17%) and the LP is burned.
unknowns: Whether Crémieux endorses a particular copy
How much of the volume is real rather than bundler/bot volume

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. The X status fetch returned 402 and the UsePaid page failed with an SSL error. General web search found nothing specific to this token.

structured_output.thesis: A tribute token for a large account, with the most volume of any copy but not the highest market cap. Bundlers, snipers and a serial deployer dominate, and it is entering after a 5x spike while 10 copies split the attention. Doubling from $247k within 6 hours is possible but below average odds for this pool.
